domain(person,[dennis,ada,collins,pablo]).

% Dennis does not seek unique results.
axiom(s1, not(seeks_unique_results(dennis))).
% Dennis respects heritage.
axiom(s2, respects_heritage(dennis)).
% Dennis pursues mastery.
axiom(s3, pursues_mastery(dennis)).
% Ada has a strong work ethic.
axiom(s4, has_strong_work_ethic(ada)).
% Dennis is passionate about printing.
axiom(s5, passionate_about_printing(dennis)).
% Ada does not seek unique results.
axiom(s6, not(seeks_unique_results(ada))).
% Collins invests time and effort.
axiom(s7, invests_time_and_effort(collins)).
% If Dennis is passionate about printing, then he respects heritage and uses traditional techniques.
axiom(s8, rule([passionate_about_printing(dennis)], and(respects_heritage(dennis), uses_traditional_techniques(dennis)))).
% For everyone who mixes inks and uses custom recipes, they can craft ink by hand.
axiom(s9, forall(var(x,person), implies(and(mixes_inks(var(x)), uses_custom_recipes(var(x))), crafts_ink_by_hand(var(x))))).
% Dennis has a strong work ethic.
axiom(s10, has_strong_work_ethic(dennis)).
% Dennis has high standards.
axiom(s11, has_high_standards(dennis)).
% Dennis invests time and effort.
axiom(s12, invests_time_and_effort(dennis)).
% If Collins has high standards, then he either pursues mastery or enjoys precision work, but not both.
axiom(s13, rule([has_high_standards(collins)], xor(pursues_mastery(collins), enjoys_precision_work(collins)))).
% If Ada is passionate about printing, then she respects heritage and uses traditional techniques.
axiom(s14, rule([passionate_about_printing(ada)], and(respects_heritage(ada), uses_traditional_techniques(ada)))).
% For all humans, if they use traditional techniques and pay attention to details, then they produce high-quality work.
axiom(s15, forall(var(x,person), implies(and(uses_traditional_techniques(var(x)), pays_attention_to_details(var(x))), produces_high_quality_work(var(x))))).
% Everyone who crafts ink by hand either values perfection or pays attention to details (or both).
axiom(s16, forall(var(x,person), implies(crafts_ink_by_hand(var(x)), or(values_perfection(var(x)), pays_attention_to_details(var(x)))))).
% If someone values perfection, then they seek unique results and invest time and effort.
axiom(s17, rule([values_perfection(X)], and(seeks_unique_results(X), invests_time_and_effort(X)))).
% If Pablo has a strong work ethic, then he either crafts ink by hand or enjoys precision work, but not both.
axiom(s18, rule([has_strong_work_ethic(pablo)], xor(crafts_ink_by_hand(pablo), enjoys_precision_work(pablo)))).
% If Dennis has a strong work ethic, then he either crafts ink by hand or enjoys precision work, but not both.
axiom(s19, rule([has_strong_work_ethic(dennis)], xor(crafts_ink_by_hand(dennis), enjoys_precision_work(dennis)))).
% If Dennis has high standards, then he either pursues mastery or enjoys precision work, but not both.
axiom(s20, rule([has_high_standards(dennis)], xor(pursues_mastery(dennis), enjoys_precision_work(dennis)))).
